title: Function-Call Generator
text: Provide function-call events to control execution of subsystem or model, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Sample time} sets time interval; {Number of iterations} sets the number of times to provide a function-call at each time, {Disallow wide output} prevents implicit expansion of output and {Show enable port} adds input port for control signal. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Number of iterations
params.values: Specify number of times to provide a function-call at each time step 1 (default) | integer

params.name: Disallow wide output
params.values: Prevent implicit expansion of output signal off (default) | on

params.name: Show enable port
params.values: Add input port for control signal off (default) | on
